_doc: Business-as-usual tasks. schedule.type: times (at: list of 'HH:MM', every day) | daily (at: 'HH:MM') | (times and daily accept an optional days list, e.g. "days": ["Mon", "Thu"]; a time before day_start_hour belongs to the night after that day) | random (per_day, Poisson) | every_shift (at the start of each shift) | none (only spawned by events, relics or supplies). work/deadline in game minutes; skill 'any' uses the analyst's average skill.

name: Shift Announcement
desc: Write up the handover notes for the incoming team.

name: Volcano webcam check
desc: Scheduled look through every volcano webcam.

name: Weekly Volcano Meeting
desc: Weekly catch-up with the volcano team on unrest and alert levels.

name: Seismic Daily Report
desc: Summarise the day's seismic activity for the duty team.

name: Volcanic Daily Report
desc: Summarise the day's volcanic activity for the duty team.

name: Seismic station outage
desc: A station has stopped sending data.

name: Data gap investigation
desc: A chunk of waveform data is missing.

name: Public enquiry email
desc: "Was that an earthquake or a truck?"

name: Media enquiry
desc: A journalist wants a quote, quickly.

name: Social media update
desc: Provide an update about recent activity.

name: Felt report review
desc: Sort through felt reports for a recent quake.

name: Daily Landslide Report
desc: Search for reported landslides for the national database.

name: Situational Awareness
desc: Search for any situations to be aware of.

name: VAAC Call
desc: Tri-weekly weather update with VAAC.

name: Weekly On-call Email
desc: Prepare and send the weekly duty staff email to the wider team.

name: Daily Test Pages
desc: Send the daily test pages to the duty team.

name: TEP Test Page
desc: Set up the weekly TEP test page and meeting.

name: Duty Team Retrospective Email
desc: Prepare and send the weekly summary of duty team roster.

name: OT Retrospective Email
desc: Prepare and send the weekly summary of staffing overtime and leave.

name: DART Health Check
desc: Check the status and health of all the DART Buoys.

name: TOAST Health Check
desc: Test the functionality of the TOAST tool.

name: CDEM Meeting
desc: Present the seismic update to the CDEM groups.

name: Failover Kit Check
desc: Check the status of the failover kit.

name: Rainfall landslide watch
desc: Heavy rain forecast. Review slip-prone areas.

name: Volcanic tremor check
desc: Tremor levels have changed at a volcano.

name: GNSS slow-slip check
desc: GPS stations are moving oddly. Slow slip event?

name: Fix the legacy script
desc: It broke again. Nobody knows why it worked in the first place.

name: Prepare ministry briefing
desc: Slides, talking points and a one-page summary.

name: Investigate phantom events
desc: The automatic system is detecting earthquakes that don't exist.

name: Media interview
desc: Live radio interview about recent activity.

name: Debunk viral post
desc: No, nobody can predict earthquakes from cloud shapes.

name: Beta tool crash
desc: The vendor's beta tool fell over.

name: Tool crash
desc: A tool has broken.

name: Exercise inject
desc: Respond to a scripted scenario message from the exercise team.

name: Volcanic unrest assessment
desc: Pull together all the data on the unrest.

name: Coordinate station repair
desc: Organise a field technician for a damaged site.

name: ShakeOut drill comms
desc: Posts and a media release for the national earthquake drill.

name: Research data request
desc: Pull a big waveform and catalogue extract for a university group.

name: Help a Pacific partner
desc: Help a partner agency locate a regional quake.

name: Patch the processing servers
desc: Apply the security patch IT left for you.

name: Update aftershock forecast
desc: Emergency management want the latest aftershock probabilities.

name: Volcano webcam review
desc: Something odd on a webcam. Steam? Cloud? Eruption?

name: Volcano webcam analysis
desc: A VDO has requested a huge analysis of webcam data

name: Commercial hazard report
desc: An engineering firm wants a seismic hazard summary for a new build.

name: Slip assessment
desc: The Natural Hazards Commission want to know if a slip was set off by rain or by a quake.

name: Paid data request
desc: A consultancy is paying for a high quality extract of recent catalogue data.

name: Council evacuation map review
desc: A regional council is paying for a review of its tsunami evacuation maps.

name: School science talk
desc: A local school wants someone to explain earthquakes to a Year 8 class.

name: Build an internal app
desc: Turn that handy script into a proper tool the whole team can use.
